verdict.rationale: Docs show a dashboard-level settings model that can be overridden per-repo via a `greptile.json` file, plus strictness levels and custom rules — implying a central default with local exceptions, which maps loosely to org-wide rollout with per-repo exceptions. However there is no evidence of an org/team admin console, bulk policy application across hundreds of repos, or centralized exception tracking/reporting at scale. missing for 10: explicit org-level policy management UI, bulk rollout tooling across many repos, and a centralized exceptions dashboard/audit trail.
